known_facts_book1: The fox king who rules Foxville, a city of civilized foxes reached through a carved arch on the road.
His private name is Dox but his official name is King Renard the Fourth.
Confers a fox's head upon Button-Bright, believing it will make the boy look as clever as he really is.
Cannot undo his own magic, so Button-Bright must keep the fox head until it is washed off elsewhere.
Hates the name of Aesop for writing of foxes as cruel and wicked.
Begs Dorothy to get him an invitation to Ozma's birthday celebration on the twenty-first.
Later attends the party in a new feather costume and white kid mittens, and kneels at Dorothy's feet on learning she is a Princess.
Becomes good friends with King Kik-a-bray of Dunkiton by the day of the celebration.

known_relations_book1.Button-Bright: The boy on whom he bestows an unwanted fox head.
known_relations_book1.Dorothy: The Princess who gets him his coveted invitation to Ozma's party.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler whose birthday celebration he longs to attend.

known_facts_book1: A little fat man who lives alone in a small house by the road and makes constant organ-like music simply by breathing.
His lungs are full of reeds like an organ's, so every breath in or out squeezes out music he cannot stop.
Sings his answers in verse and calls himself 'Allegro da Capo, a very famous man'.
Begs to be taken along to play the loveliest song on Ozma's birthday.
Is not invited to the party by Ozma, who fears his ceaseless noise would disturb the other guests.
Button-Bright likes his music, though Dorothy and the shaggy man do not.

known_relations_book1.Button-Bright: The one traveler who genuinely likes his music.
known_relations_book1.Shaggy Man: Repeatedly begs him to stop the dreadful noise.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler who declines to invite him to her celebration.

known_facts_book1: A funny little man with a long grey beard and a worn leather apron who sits on a big copper chest full of magic tools.
Is summoned by the shaggy man through the Love Magnet with a two-line rhyme, and never wastes time.
Builds a sand-boat with runners and a sail in minutes so the party can cross the Deadly Desert without touching the deadly sands.
Sings a song while he works: 'The only way to do a thing / Is do it when you can.'
Vanishes with his tools the instant the boat is finished, too busy to hear thanks.
Attends the birthday celebration, eats heartily, and builds a great flying machine on the platform in which he flies away.

known_relations_book1.Shaggy Man: His friend, who summons him by the Love Magnet in the party's hour of need.
known_relations_book1.Dorothy: One of the travelers he helps across the desert.
